definitions.relevance: Exact evidence URL match; article-level proxy, not passage fact verification
definitions.recall: Unique evidence articles found in top-k passages / unique gold evidence articles
definitions.mrr: Mean reciprocal rank of first evidence-article passage within k; zero if absent
definitions.all_hop_coverage: Fraction of questions with every unique evidence article in top-k passages
definitions.aggregation: Macro average over questions with nonempty evidence; others excluded
definitions.ranking: Original passage ranks, no article deduplication before cutoff
definitions.mrr_limit: MRR is truncated at k; saved top-50 cannot establish unrestricted MRR
